description: Add/replace columns via inline SQL expressions (CTAS pushdown). Alteryx Formula In-DB equivalent.

database_url.label: Database URL
database_url.description: SQLAlchemy URL. Set this OR database_url_env_var.

database_url_env_var.label: Database URL Env Var
database_url_env_var.description: Env var with the URL. Set this OR database_url.

expressions.label: Expressions
expressions.description: Map of output_col → SQL expression (inlined verbatim into SELECT).

keep_existing.label: Keep Existing
keep_existing.description: true: SELECT *, <new>. false + keep_columns: those cols + new. false alone: only new.

keep_columns.label: Keep Columns
keep_columns.description: Explicit projection of original columns to retain when keep_existing=false.

deps.label: Deps
deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Additional key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds for the Dagster catalog.

include_preview_metadata.label: Include Preview Metadata
include_preview_metadata.description: Include a preview of the output data in metadata (sample rows) for builder UIs.

preview_rows.label: Preview Rows
preview_rows.description: Rows to include in the preview metadata when `include_preview_metadata` is True.
